name: smwgraphics-lamia-naga
title: Lamia / Naga
description:
Anorakun's notes: A lamia / naga creature that replaces the Rex sprite, made by No-Body the Dragon. I added some colors to the tail, since it was using blue for the top half and bottom part. I also used the second half to color the squished form to green. I made some slight changes in the color, but only that. Credit still goes to No Body the Dragon / No Body, from Mario Fan Games Galaxy. Can fit some ruins / pyramid / castles levels, in general.

Uses vanilla palette.
